title: About BFT Kampong Ubi
text:
BFT Kampong Ubi is a group fitness training studio that runs progressive, science-backed workouts led by certified coaches.

We are an authorised HYROX training facility, making us one of the best places to train for HYROX events in Singapore.

Studio address: 414 Upper Paya Lebar Rd, Singapore 534994
Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/NFmW1gHq6U5WjhCT7
Official website: https://www.bodyfittraining.au/club/kampong-ubi

What we offer:
- Group fitness classes (strength, cardio, and functional training)
- Progressive programming that adapts as you improve
- Certified coaches in every session
- Trial options for new members (free first class or 10-session trial pack)
- Heart rate monitoring with BFT³ devices

We are a fitness-only studio — we do not offer food, drinks, coffee, or childcare.

title: How BFT Training Works
text:
BFT offers 50-minute strength-based group training sessions tailored to all fitness levels, focusing on cardio, strength, functional movement, and balance. Every exercise can be modified up or down, so beginners and advanced members can train side by side safely.

While classes run in a group setting, the coaching style delivers personal-training-like benefits: coaches give hands-on form correction and individual attention, and are all trained to give nutrition advice too. It's not 1:1 personal training, but it delivers similar results at a lower cost, with the added motivation of a group environment.

title: Why Train With Us
text:
- Scientifically designed, high-performance group training methods
- Wide variety of 50-minute classes (strength, cardio, core, and more)
- Progression-based programming that builds over time
- Small studio with a high coach-to-member ratio for more personalised attention
- Exclusive VIP Lounge for rest, recovery, and recharge — one of the only BFT studios with a space this size
- On-site yoga studio with weekly stretch/yoga sessions
- Pantry and co-working space
- Premium shower facilities with bath towels and amenities provided
- Expert coaching team, including HYROX podium finishers, an ACE Academy coach, mixed martial arts-trained coaches, sports physio-trained coaches, and a master nutritionist
- Weekly HYROX-specific training (not included in the trial)
- Regular wellness workshops and community events

title: About BFT (Body Fit Training)
text:
BFT (Body Fit Training) was founded in 2017 in Melbourne, Australia, by Cameron Falloon. It has since grown into a global franchise with structured programming across 14 workout types, operating 300+ studios across Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Hong Kong, Malaysia, Indonesia, South Korea, the UK, the US, Canada, Spain, and Portugal, with further expansion underway in Scandinavia and the MENA region (including a flagship studio in Qatar).

Membership gives you the flexibility to train at any BFT studio worldwide — ideal for frequent travellers or anyone relocating.

Note: trial offers are only valid at the specific studio where they were claimed and cannot be used at other locations.

title: Class Schedule and Format
text:
BFT Kampong Ubi runs group training sessions Monday to Saturday. Each session lasts 50 minutes and is capped at a maximum of 36 members per class, so it's worth booking ahead.

Weekday class times (Monday–Friday):
- Morning: 6:05 AM, 7:10 AM, 8:15 AM
- Midday: 12:30 PM
- Evening: 5:30 PM, 6:35 PM, 7:40 PM

Saturday class times:
- 6:30 AM (HYROX)
- 8:00 AM, 9:15 AM, 10:30 AM, 11:45 AM

The studio is closed on Sundays, with no regular classes that day.

Programming follows a structured 10-week training block that combines resistance training, cardio intervals, and core work, so members progress systematically rather than doing random workouts week to week.

title: How to Book and Cancel Classes
text:
Classes can be booked up to 7 days in advance through either the BFT app or the BFT Kampong Ubi website. Simply log in, select an available time slot, and confirm your booking before the class reaches its 36-person capacity.

If you can't make a class, cancel at least 2 hours before the scheduled start time. Cancelling later than that is treated as a late cancellation and incurs a $10 late cancel fee. This policy helps keep spots fairly available for all members.

title: Studio Manager Contact
text: For help with bookings, appointments, or anything the app or website can't resolve, you can contact the studio manager directly at +65 8919 0460.

title: What to Bring & Studio Rules
text:
What to bring:
- Comfortable workout clothes that allow a full range of movement
- Training shoes with clean, non-marking soles, suitable for both cardio and strength work
- A water bottle to stay hydrated through the 50-minute session
- A small towel for personal use during and after class

Lockers are available on-site for storing personal belongings while you train. Please arrive 5–10 minutes before your class starts to allow time to set up.

Studio rules:
- No pets or animals of any kind
- No outside food permitted in the studio
- Water bottles are welcome
- The studio does not sell or serve coffee, food, or drinks

title: Is BFT Suitable for Beginners?
text:
Yes — BFT Kampong Ubi classes are designed for beginners and experienced members alike. Every exercise has a modification option, so coaches can adjust movements to match each person's fitness level, experience, or any physical limitations.

This means newcomers, people returning after a break, or anyone managing a specific concern can train safely alongside more advanced members, and progress at their own pace over time.

title: Coach Qualifications and Experience
text:
All coaches at BFT Kampong Ubi hold accredited personal training certifications and have a minimum of 2 years of hands-on coaching experience. Many are also trained specifically for HYROX-style workouts, and several have completed HYROX races themselves, bringing first-hand race experience to their coaching.

The head coach, Marcus, has 8 years of experience in functional fitness and specialises in helping beginners build strength safely and progressively.

All coaches take part in quarterly BFT methodology training updates, keeping their programming, coaching cues, and safety practices current and consistent across every session.

title: Membership Plans and Pricing
text:
BFT Kampong Ubi offers three main membership options:

- 10-Class Pack: $280, valid for 60 days from purchase — best for those who want flexibility without a recurring commitment
- Monthly Unlimited: $169/month, no lock-in contract — unlimited classes, cancel any time
- 12-Month Committed: $139/month with a 12-month agreement — the lowest monthly rate in exchange for a longer commitment

All new members are also entitled to one completely free trial class before choosing a plan (see Trial Offers).

Membership can be set up and paid for via the BFT app or in person at the studio:
iOS: https://apps.apple.com/au/app/bft-booking/id1313264094
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.onefitstop.bodyfittraining

IMPORTANT for the AI agent: when presenting sign-up information, always cover all three parts — trial options, membership plans, and payment method. Never skip any part.

title: Membership Cancellation and Suspension
text:
The Monthly Unlimited plan has no lock-in contract, so you can cancel at any time. Cancellations require 2 weeks' notice, and any billing that falls within that 2-week notice period will still be charged.

Members can also suspend their membership for up to 12 weeks per year at no charge. Suspension requests need 1 week's notice and must be for a minimum of 7 days.

Note: the 12-Month Committed plan involves a 12-month agreement — confirm early-exit terms with the studio for members on this plan.

title: How to Approach Membership Pricing Questions
text:
When a lead asks about membership pricing or post-trial options, don't just list numbers immediately. First understand their requirements and fitness goals, then recommend the membership option that best fits.

Trial classes are a good opportunity for both sides — they help the member understand their own fitness goals, and help the studio understand what the member needs. It's often best to have the detailed pricing conversation once they've come in for a trial class.

title: Age Requirements and Supervision
text: Participants must be at least 16 years old to attend classes. If someone under 16 wants to join, parental supervision is mandatory, and the parent must accompany the minor during workout sessions.

title: Membership Transfer Policy
text: Memberships, packages, and passes must be registered under the name of the person attending the classes. They are not transferable or shareable, so only the individual who signed up can participate.

title: BFT³ Overview
text: BFT³ is Body Fit Training's exclusive heart rate monitoring system designed to personalize workouts and track performance in real time. It combines science, gamification, and smart data.

title: PXI Rewards
text: Members unlock rewards and levels by achieving PXI targets like 1800+ per month — promoting consistency and long-term motivation.

title: PXI Scoring
text:
PXI is calculated based on:
- Time spent in target heart rate zones
- How consistently you hit the session's intended heart rate zone
- Duration and effort across the session

This encourages training smarter, not just harder.

title: BFT³ Real-Time Feedback
text:
- Live heart rate and PXI score shown on studio screens
- Helps members adjust effort during the workout
- Keeps motivation and focus high

title: Heart Rate Zones
text:
| Zone | Intensity | % HRmax | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Very Light | 50–60% | Warm-up, active recovery |
| 2 | Light | 60–70% | Builds endurance, burns fat |
| 3 | Moderate | 70–80% | Improves aerobic capacity |
| 4 | Hard | 80–90% | Boosts speed, fitness |
| 5 | Maximum Effort | 90–100% | Sprint or high-intensity peaks |

BFT³ rewards zone-specific accuracy, not just effort.

title: Understanding HYROX Training and Race Format
text: Hyrox training involves preparing for an endurance race that combines running and functional workouts. The Hyrox race format includes a series of eight 1 km runs, each followed by a functional fitness workout like sled pushes, rowing, burpees, or wall balls. This structure challenges both cardiovascular and muscular endurance, making Hyrox training a dynamic and comprehensive form of fitness preparation.

title: Preparing for HYROX During the Week
text: Our regular training programs are well-suited for HYROX competitions. While full race simulations typically occur on Saturdays or Sundays, you can still prepare during our weekday sessions, Monday to Friday, which are designed to improve your performance in HYROX events.

title: Overview of the BFT Kampong Ubi Reset Challenge
text: The BFT Reset Challenge at BFT Kampong Ubi is an 8‑week structured training and lifestyle program designed to help participants reset habits, improve fitness performance, or change body composition. It combines BFT group training, personalised nutrition, ongoing accountability, coach support, and community events. The program is open to both existing BFT Kampong Ubi members and non‑members, with different pricing and access depending on membership status.

title: Reset Challenge Streams and Selection Process
text: During onboarding into the Challenge Hub, each participant selects one Reset Challenge stream: Lifestyle, Perform, or Transform. This choice guides the education they receive, the coaching emphasis, and how accountability is structured. The selected stream aligns with each participant's primary goal—habit building, performance enhancement, or physical transformation—and informs how coaches and resources are tailored throughout the 8 weeks.

title: Eligibility and Who Can Join the Reset Challenge
text: The BFT Kampong Ubi Reset Challenge is open to both current BFT Kampong Ubi members and non‑members. It caters to a wide range of fitness levels, from beginners to advanced trainees, because the three streams—Lifestyle, Perform, and Transform—allow participants to choose a path that matches their goals and experience. Non‑members can use the challenge as a structured entry point into regular training with BFT.

title: Key Focus Areas of the Lifestyle Stream
text: The Lifestyle Stream centres on building and reinforcing positive daily habits. Education and coaching focus on nutrition fundamentals, improving sleep quality, managing mindset, and strengthening personal accountability. The objective is to help participants implement realistic, sustainable lifestyle changes rather than quick fixes, supporting long‑term consistency and general wellbeing.

title: Lifestyle Stream Goals and Ideal Participants
text: The Lifestyle Stream is best suited to participants who want to build consistent routines and improve overall health rather than chase specific performance or physique milestones. It is aimed at people focusing on everyday wellness, including nutrition, sleep, mindset, and daily habits. This stream is ideal for those looking to reset their lifestyle, improve energy, and create sustainable, long‑term behaviour change.

title: Perform Stream Goals and Ideal Participants
text: The Perform Stream is tailored for participants who want to enhance athletic performance, train for specific events such as HYROX or races, or push measurable strength and fitness benchmarks. It suits individuals who already have a base level of training and are looking to fine‑tune their performance, increase speed, power, and endurance, and perform better in competitive or goal‑driven settings.

title: Key Focus Areas of the Perform Stream
text: The Perform Stream emphasises performance‑oriented nutrition, optimal fuelling before and after sessions, and structured recovery strategies. Participants receive coach consultations focused on training optimisation, helping them plan sessions, manage workload, and align nutrition with performance targets. The stream is designed to maximise physical output and efficiency while reducing the risk of overtraining.

title: Transform Stream Goals and Ideal Participants
text: The Transform Stream is designed for participants whose primary goal is physical change, such as improving body composition, losing body fat, or gaining muscle. It appeals to individuals who are motivated by measurable physique results and want structured guidance to track and drive those changes over the 8 weeks.

title: Key Focus Areas of the Transform Stream
text: The Transform Stream focuses on data‑driven body composition tracking using Evolt scans, combined with results‑oriented nutrition planning. Coaches support participants with goal setting, accountability, and consistent training and nutrition adherence. Progress is monitored through objective metrics and regular check‑ins to keep participants aligned with their transformation targets.

title: Coach Consultations and Stream-Tailored Guidance
text: As part of the Reset Challenge, participants receive coach consultations that are aligned with their chosen stream. These sessions typically cover goal setting, review of Evolt or other progress scans, and development of concrete action plans for training and nutrition. Coaches help participants interpret their data, refine their strategies, and stay accountable to their commitments throughout the challenge.

title: Program Components of the BFT Reset Challenge
text: The BFT Reset Challenge is built around several integrated components: structured BFT group training sessions, personalised nutrition planning, and accountability tools to track habits and progress. Participants receive guidance and check‑ins from coaches as well as support from the broader BFT community through studio‑led events. Together, these elements create a comprehensive approach to training, nutrition, and lifestyle change over the 8 weeks.

title: Personalised Nutrition Plans in the Reset Challenge
text: Every participant in the Reset Challenge receives access to personalised nutrition plans. These plans offer multiple calorie‑based options to suit different body types and goals, along with customisable meal ideas. Each plan includes a breakdown of macronutrients and calories, plus weekly shopping lists to simplify food preparation. This structure helps participants align their eating habits with their chosen stream and desired outcomes.

title: Accountability Tracking Tools in the Reset Challenge
text: The Reset Challenge uses structured accountability trackers to help participants stay consistent. These tools monitor training attendance, nutrition adherence, and key lifestyle behaviours such as sleep and daily habits. By tracking these inputs regularly, participants and coaches can identify patterns, address obstacles, and make adjustments that support better outcomes across all streams.

title: Challenge Hub Features and Benefits
text: All Reset Challenge participants receive access to the Challenge Hub, a central digital platform for managing their 8‑week journey. Within the Hub, members can set goals, complete daily and weekly checklists, and monitor their progress over time. The platform also provides educational content tailored to each stream, helping participants understand training, nutrition, and habit strategies relevant to their goals.

title: Studio Events During the BFT Reset Challenge
text: Participants gain access to a range of studio‑hosted events throughout the challenge. These may include educational workshops, community training sessions, and special mid‑challenge and end‑of‑challenge events. The events are designed to build community, deepen knowledge, keep motivation high, and celebrate progress at key milestones.

title: Competitions and Prizes in the Reset Challenge
text: All Reset Challenge participants are eligible for studio‑based competitions and prize opportunities. Awards may be stream‑specific, recognising achievements within Lifestyle, Perform, or Transform, as well as rewards tied to accountability, such as consistent attendance or adherence to program tasks. These incentives are intended to keep members engaged and recognise effort and progress, not just end results.

title: Sign-Up Process for Members
text: Existing BFT Kampong Ubi members can register for the Reset Challenge either in person at the studio or through the studio's official communication channels. Once registered, they will be onboarded into the Challenge Hub, where they can choose their stream, set goals, and access all program resources.

title: Sign-Up Process and Access for Non-Members
text: Non‑members interested in the BFT Kampong Ubi Reset Challenge are guided through a multi‑step onboarding process. This includes completing challenge registration, activating temporary 8‑week unlimited access to BFT classes for the challenge period, and being set up in the Challenge Hub. Through this process, non‑members gain the same program tools and support as existing members while experiencing BFT training for the duration of the challenge.

title: Evolt Body Composition Scans in the Reset Challenge
text: Evolt body composition scans are an important element of the BFT Reset Challenge, especially for participants in the Transform Stream. Initial scans are recommended shortly before each challenge begins, to help set realistic goals, guide selection of the appropriate nutrition plan, and provide a baseline for tracking progress. Additional scans may be offered during or after the challenge depending on studio guidance and the participant's stream.
